agentUtterance.text:
Yes, all certified Pre-owned phone come with a one-year limited warranty from Bell. This warranty covers manufacturer's defects for one year. The warranty does not cover physical, liquid damage or the charging cable. For added protection you can also add a Smart/Phone Care plan to your Certified Pre-owned phone at time of purchase which covers lost, theft, physical damage or defects outside the warranty.
Have you enrolled in our smart care program?
I can send you an email with a link to learn more about our in-store device repair process or additional options. Is that alright?
